note: Read by 3ds/tools/azt.ps1. debug = the -Debug switch string of run_azahar.ps1, until = its -Until regex, cap = -Timeout in s, extra = more run_azahar.ps1 switches. first_marker is a log regex that must appear within deadline s after the Azahar start. expects = warp | tour | none (warp and tour turn on the attract-loop check). expected_events are log regexes that must all appear. An expected_event with max is a numeric gate: capture group 1 of its regex must be at most max (pick last takes the last matching line, else the first). status = verified | unverified | completion_only | fail_demo | pending.
